style: Create original high-fantasy game art with chunky hand-inked dark contours, flat gouache-like color masses and restrained dry-brush texture. Heroic dragon-blooded fantasy with blackened iron, copper-red scales, ivory horn and warm ember fire; bold readable silhouettes, two-step cel shading and selective warm highlights; reserve soft emission for active fire and VFX. This is an ORIGINAL character: do not imitate any existing game, champion, franchise character, costume, emblem or official artwork. Include no text, letters, numerals, labels, logos, emblems, watermarks or typographic symbols, and respect each asset's stated background and framing requirements. For combatant animation sheets, use cohesive hand-painted animation cels with organic hand-inked contours, flat gouache masses, restrained dry-brush texture confined inside painted forms and clean anti-aliased transparent edges. Do not use pixel art, pixel-grid outlines, nearest-neighbor blocks, photorealism or glossy 3D rendering. Keep the same character model, proportions, palette, equipment placement, lighting, contour weight and texture density from frame to frame and across all sheets. Use a locked camera, constant character scale, equal-width horizontal cells and a shared ground line; reserve generous transparent space for the complete action silhouette and effects within every cell. Keep silhouettes readable at gameplay size; no scenery, floor, contact shadows, cast shadows, registration marks or cell dividers. Apply the same painted treatment and character identity to portraits, following their individual crops.

assets.prompt: Vera Emberscale is an original half-dragon adult woman warrior with an athletic, muscular build, light warm brown skin, and a cute face drawn in a Japanese anime style (about 4 on a 10-point cuteness scale: still a grown adult warrior, never childish): large expressive bright amber (#F2A93B) anime eyes with slit dragon pupils, strong glossy eye highlights and defined upper lashes, thin gently arched brows, a soft V-shaped anime jawline, a tiny simplified nose drawn with a single small stroke, a small mouth with a confident playful smile, and clean cel-shaded skin on the face. Her body stays just as athletic and muscular as described and keeps the painted style; only the face is drawn anime-style. Two short ivory (#EFE2C4) horns sweep straight BACKWARD from just above her temples; her ears are small ROUNDED human ears mostly covered by hair (absolutely no pointed ears, no elf ears, no fins, no crest). Her deep crimson (#8E1B23, shadows #4A0F18) hair has short choppy bangs and is woven into ONE thick long braid bound by three copper rings, hanging behind her toward the LEFT. A few small crimson scales dot her cheekbones and the outer sides of her upper arms. A thick crimson-scaled dragon tail as long as her legs emerges behind her hips and curls down to the LEFT, ending in a blunt spade tip. She wears a blackened-iron (#2A2426) plate breastplate with an open V neckline while opaque armor securely covers her chest, an abdomen and thighs of overlapping copper-red (#B5532E) dragon-scale mail, a matching pair of small rounded blackened-iron pauldrons, each edged with a row of three ivory spikes, on BOTH shoulders (always visible on whichever shoulder faces the viewer), a short torn crimson cloth tabard hanging from a copper-buckled belt, and iron greaves with boots. Her signature weapons are her hands: both forearms are sheathed in heavy copper-red dragon-scale gauntlets ending in four long curved black-iron claws on each hand, with thin glowing ember-orange (#FF8A2A) cracks between the scales. She holds NO sword, NO spear, NO axe and NO shield; she carries nothing on her back except her braid. Keep this same adult face, skin tone, horns, braid, tail, claws and equipment sides in every asset; never mirror the design. Use a grounded, strong warrior posture suitable for general-audience fantasy, without sexualized posing or exaggerated chest or hips. exactly 4 frames in a single horizontal row, equal-width cells, the SAME character at the SAME size and the SAME ground line in every frame, full body, facing RIGHT, clear empty gap between frames, nothing crosses a cell border, fully transparent background (no dark backdrop, no vignette, no glow haze or colored fog behind the character; glow only on the embers themselves), no text, no grid lines, no motion trail outside the cell. Read the action frames from left to right. Use the same fixed camera and character scale as her idle sheet. STRICT CELL RULE: divide the image width into equal cells; every pixel of a frame, including braid, tail, claws and embers, must stay inside that frame's own cell with a clear transparent gap to the neighboring cells. Each cell is wide enough for her full body lying down. Place the lowest point of the body at approximately 94 percent of cell height, leaving at least 6 percent clear margin on all sides. No ground plane, contact shadow or cast shadow. This is her defeat, a dignified warrior's collapse suitable for general audiences. Frame 1: struck by a final unseen blow from the right, she staggers upright, torso bent slightly forward, one clawed hand pressed to her stomach armor, eyes squeezed shut, teeth gritted; feet still in the idle stance. Frame 2: her knees buckle, she sinks lower but is still mostly upright, arms dropping, head lowering, braid and tail sagging. Frame 3: she has dropped onto her left knee, right claw planted on the ground in front of her to hold herself up, head bowed with eyes closed, the ember cracks in her gauntlets dimming to dull red. Frame 4: she has collapsed fully forward and lies face-down on the ground line along the cell, head toward the RIGHT, eyes closed, braid and tail limp on the ground, gauntlets dark with only one or two faint ember sparks rising. Show defeat through posture only: no blood, no wounds, no attacker, no weapons dropped, no wings, no fire burst, no slash effect.
